sentence: If we denote the coordinates of points \( L \) and \( P \) as \( L \) and \( P \) respectively, the length of \( LP \) is \( |P - L| \).

sentence: The coordinate of \( M \) can be calculated by adding one-third of the distance from \( L \) to \( P \) to the coordinate of \( L \).
